text: 身无彩凤双飞翼，心有灵犀一点通
pinyin: shēn wú cǎi fèng shuāng fēi yì, xīn yǒu líng xī yī diǎn tōng
literal: body · no · coloured · phoenix · pair · flying · wings, heart · have · spirit · rhino horn · one · point · connect
natural: I have no phoenix wings to fly beside you, but our hearts are linked by a single thread of understanding

meaning.en: Though apart, two hearts understand each other without words; quoted for telepathic closeness between lovers or friends.
meaning.zh: 身上没有彩凤的双翼不能飞到你身边，心却像灵犀一样相通，形容彼此默契。

examples.zh: 他们俩不用说话，真是“身无彩凤双飞翼，心有灵犀一点通”。
examples.en: Those two need no words: truly '§'.

examples.zh: 情人节贺卡上写着“身无彩凤双飞翼，心有灵犀一点通”。
examples.en: The Valentine's card said '§'.

origin.source: 李商隐《无题·昨夜星辰昨夜风》

story.en: From one of Li Shangyin's 'Untitled' love poems, written about a banquet and a longing for someone he cannot reach.
story.zh: 李商隐《无题》，写宴会后对意中人的思念。

usage.en: Quoted for tacit understanding; the second half is also used alone as 心有灵犀。
usage.zh: 常指心意相通，后半句也单独引用。

text: 夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏
pinyin: xī yáng wú xiàn hǎo, zhǐ shì jìn huáng hūn
literal: setting sun · no · limit · beautiful, only · is · near · dusk
natural: The setting sun is infinitely lovely, only it is close to dusk

meaning.en: Something beautiful is near its end; quoted of old age, or of a fading golden moment.
meaning.zh: 夕阳虽然美好，但已近黄昏，比喻美好事物将逝，也常指晚年。

equivalents: the glory of the sunset years

examples.zh: 老人退休后感叹“夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏”。
examples.en: The retiree sighed '§'.

examples.zh: 这家老字号虽然辉煌，却是“夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏”。
examples.en: The old brand was glorious, but '§'.

story.en: Li Shangyin, feeling low, climbed Leyou Plain at dusk and wrote these lines; they can be read as lament or as appreciation.
story.zh: 李商隐傍晚登乐游原，心绪不佳而作，可解作感伤，亦可解作赞叹。

usage.en: Used both as a lament and, in modern times, as encouragement for the elderly (with a changed tone).
usage.zh: 既可表感伤，也有人反其意以勉励老年人。

text: 君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池
pinyin: jūn wèn guī qī wèi yǒu qī, bā shān yè yǔ zhǎng qiū chí
literal: you · ask · return · date · not yet · have · date, Ba · mountain · night · rain · swell · autumn · pond
natural: You ask when I'll return; I cannot say. Night rain in the Ba mountains swells the autumn pools

meaning.en: Homesick and unable to say when he can go home; quoted for uncertain return.
meaning.zh: 你问我何时回家，我也不知道，巴山夜雨涨满秋池，写思念与归期难定。

equivalents: can't say when I'll be home
a rainy night of missing home

examples.zh: 面对家人催问，他只能说“君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池”。
examples.en: Pressed by his family, he could only say '§'.

examples.zh: 外派的日子里，他常想起“君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池”。
examples.en: Posted abroad, he often thought of '§'.

story.en: Li Shangyin, posted to Sichuan, writes to his family (or wife) in the north on a rainy autumn night.
story.zh: 李商隐客居巴蜀，秋夜雨中寄给北方亲人。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 嫦娥应悔偷灵药，碧海青天夜夜心
pinyin: cháng é yīng huǐ tōu líng yào, bì hǎi qīng tiān yè yè xīn
literal: Chang'e · surely · regret · steal · elixir, blue · sea · blue · sky · night · night · heart
natural: Chang'e must regret stealing the elixir: every night, a blue sea and sky, her lonely heart

meaning.en: Eternal loneliness as the price of a bold choice; quoted of lonely immortality or regret.
meaning.zh: 嫦娥一定后悔偷了仙药，夜夜面对碧海青天，孤独难耐，比喻孤寂与悔恨。

equivalents: lonely heart under the night sky

examples.zh: 在高位多年的他，常有“嫦娥应悔偷灵药，碧海青天夜夜心”之叹。
examples.en: After many years at the top, he often sighed '§'.

examples.zh: 读这句“嫦娥应悔偷灵药，碧海青天夜夜心”，只觉月光冷清。
examples.en: Reading '§', I felt only the cold moonlight.

story.en: Li Shangyin's poem retells the myth of Chang'e who took the elixir of immortality and flew to the moon.
story.zh: 李商隐《嫦娥》，咏嫦娥偷食灵药奔月的传说。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 千里莺啼绿映红，水村山郭酒旗风
pinyin: qiān lǐ yīng tí lǜ yìng hóng, shuǐ cūn shān guō jiǔ qí fēng
literal: thousand · li · orioles · sing · green · set off · red, water · villages · mountain · walls · wine · flag · wind
natural: Orioles sing for a thousand li, green setting off red; wine-shop flags flutter in water villages and hill towns

meaning.en: A vivid panorama of spring in the Jiangnan region.
meaning.zh: 千里江南莺啼声声，绿树红花相映，水乡山城酒旗迎风，描绘江南春景。

examples.zh: 三月的江南，正是“千里莺啼绿映红，水村山郭酒旗风”。
examples.en: Jiangnan in March is just '§'.

examples.zh: 宣传片里配了“千里莺啼绿映红，水村山郭酒旗风”的字幕。
examples.en: The promo film was captioned with '§'.

story.en: Du Mu paints Jiangnan in spring; the poem ends by referring to the many temples left from the Southern Dynasties.
story.zh: 杜牧《江南春》，末句写南朝遗留的众多寺庙。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 清明时节雨纷纷，路上行人欲断魂
pinyin: qīng míng shí jié yǔ fēn fēn, lù shàng xíng rén yù duàn hún
literal: Qingming · season · rain · thick · thick, road · on · travellers · nearly · break · soul
natural: Rain drizzles on Qingming; travellers on the road are nearly heartbroken

meaning.en: The melancholy of rainy Qingming, the tomb-sweeping festival.
meaning.zh: 清明时节细雨纷纷，路上的行人心情低落，写清明的哀愁。

examples.zh: 每年清明下雨，大家都说“清明时节雨纷纷，路上行人欲断魂”。
examples.en: It rains every Qingming, and everyone says '§'.

examples.zh: 扫墓的路上，他想起“清明时节雨纷纷，路上行人欲断魂”。
examples.en: On the way to sweep the tomb he thought of '§'.

story.en: A short poem attributed to Du Mu about a rainy Qingming, which ends with a shepherd boy pointing to a village inn.
story.zh: 相传为杜牧所作，末句牧童遥指杏花村。

usage.en: Very commonly quoted around Qingming; authorship is traditional.
usage.zh: 清明前后常被引用，作者归属为传统说法。

text: 远上寒山石径斜，白云生处有人家
pinyin: yuǎn shàng hán shān shí jìng xié, bái yún shēng chù yǒu rén jiā
literal: far · climb · cold · mountain · stone · path · slanting, white · clouds · arise · place · have · households
natural: Up the cold mountain a stone path winds; where white clouds rise there are homes

meaning.en: A tranquil autumn mountain scene, with a hint of hidden dwellings.
meaning.zh: 石径蜿蜒向上通到寒山，白云深处还有人家，描绘宁静的秋山。

equivalents: a mountain path to homes among the clouds

examples.zh: 徒步到山顶，发现真是“远上寒山石径斜，白云生处有人家”。
examples.en: Hiking to the summit, I found it really was '§'.

examples.zh: 国画的题诗写的是“远上寒山石径斜，白云生处有人家”。
examples.en: The poem inscribed on the painting reads '§'.

story.en: Du Mu's 'Mountain Walk', an autumn outing; the following lines are about the maple leaves.
story.zh: 杜牧《山行》，下句写停车赏枫。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 停车坐爱枫林晚，霜叶红于二月花
pinyin: tíng chē zuò ài fēng lín wǎn, shuāng yè hóng yú èr yuè huā
literal: stop · carriage · because · love · maple · forest · evening, frosted · leaves · redder · than · second · month · flowers
natural: I stop my carriage, for I love the maple woods at dusk; frost-touched leaves are redder than February flowers

meaning.en: Autumn can be as beautiful as spring; quoted for autumn colours and positive outlook.
meaning.zh: 停车只因喜爱傍晚枫林，经霜的红叶比二月春花更红，赞美秋色之美。

equivalents: autumn leaves redder than spring flowers

examples.zh: 香山红叶漫山遍野，正是“停车坐爱枫林晚，霜叶红于二月花”。
examples.en: The red leaves of Fragrant Hills blanket the mountain: just '§'.

examples.zh: “停车坐爱枫林晚，霜叶红于二月花”，秋天未必输给春天。
examples.en: '§': autumn is not necessarily inferior to spring.

story.en: The second half of Du Mu's 'Mountain Walk': he halts his cart to admire the maples.
story.zh: 《山行》后半，作者停车赏枫。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 商女不知亡国恨，隔江犹唱后庭花
pinyin: shāng nǚ bù zhī wáng guó hèn, gé jiāng yóu chàng hòu tíng huā
literal: singing · girls · not · know · lost · state · grief, across · river · still · sing · Backyard · Flowers
natural: The singing girls know nothing of the grief of a fallen state; across the river they still sing 'Flowers in the Backyard'

meaning.en: Criticism of those who indulge in pleasure while the country is in danger; quoted to rebuke decadence.
meaning.zh: 歌女不懂亡国之恨，仍唱着亡国之音，实则讽刺沉迷享乐的权贵。

examples.zh: 国难当头还在狂欢，不禁想起“商女不知亡国恨，隔江犹唱后庭花”。
examples.en: Revelling while the nation is in peril, one cannot help thinking of '§'.

examples.zh: 评论文章借“商女不知亡国恨，隔江犹唱后庭花”批评奢靡之风。
examples.en: The commentary used '§' to criticise extravagance.

story.en: Du Mu moored on the Qinhuai and heard singers perform the 'Backyard Flowers', a song linked with the fall of the Chen dynasty.
story.zh: 杜牧夜泊秦淮，闻歌女唱《玉树后庭花》（陈后主所作，被视为亡国之音）。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 银烛秋光冷画屏，轻罗小扇扑流萤
pinyin: yín zhú qiū guāng lěng huà píng, qīng luó xiǎo shàn pū liú yíng
literal: silver · candle · autumn · light · cold · painted · screen, light · silk · small · fan · swat · drifting · fireflies
natural: Silver candlelight, autumn glow, a chilly painted screen; with a small silk fan she swats at the drifting fireflies

meaning.en: A lonely palace lady's autumn night; quoted for a quiet, wistful scene.
meaning.zh: 秋夜烛光映着冰冷的画屏，宫女执小扇扑打流萤，写孤寂。

examples.zh: 夏末的庭院里，他想起“银烛秋光冷画屏，轻罗小扇扑流萤”。
examples.en: In the courtyard at summer's end he thought of '§'.

examples.zh: 这幅仕女图的题诗是“银烛秋光冷画屏，轻罗小扇扑流萤”。
examples.en: The poem on this painting of a lady is '§'.

story.en: A palace-lament poem by Du Mu; the closing lines turn to gazing at the Weaver Girl star.
story.zh: 杜牧《秋夕》，末句写坐看牵牛织女星。

usage.en: Literary; a classic palace-lament image.
usage.zh: 书面语，典型的宫怨诗意象。

text: 东风不与周郎便，铜雀春深锁二乔
pinyin: dōng fēng bù yǔ zhōu láng biàn, tóng què chūn shēn suǒ èr qiáo
literal: east · wind · not · give · Zhou · Lang · convenience, Bronze · Sparrow · spring · deep · lock · two · Qiao
natural: If the east wind had not helped General Zhou, the Bronze Sparrow Terrace would have locked the two Qiaos away in deep spring

meaning.en: Victory hinged on a stroke of luck; quoted when a small chance decides the outcome.
meaning.zh: 若东风不助周瑜，二乔就将被锁进铜雀台，说明成败取决于一点机缘。

examples.zh: 这场比赛的结果有点“东风不与周郎便，铜雀春深锁二乔”，全靠运气。
examples.en: The result of this game was a bit '§': pure luck.

examples.zh: 他在文章里引用“东风不与周郎便，铜雀春深锁二乔”，讲历史的偶然性。
examples.en: In his essay he quoted '§' to discuss chance in history.

story.en: Du Mu mused on the Battle of Red Cliffs (208): had the east wind not fanned Zhou Yu's fire attack, Cao Cao would have won.
story.zh: 杜牧凭吊赤壁，议论赤壁之战中东风助周瑜火攻的历史偶然。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 胜败兵家事不期，包羞忍耻是男儿
pinyin: shèng bài bīng jiā shì bù qī, bāo xiū rěn chǐ shì nán ér
literal: win · lose · military · men · matter · not · foreseeable, wrap · shame · endure · disgrace · is · real · man
natural: Victory and defeat are unpredictable in war; a real man bears shame and humiliation

meaning.en: Setbacks are normal; a strong person endures disgrace and tries again.
meaning.zh: 胜败是兵家常事，难以预料，能忍受羞辱再起的才是真男儿。

examples.zh: 比赛输了，教练说“胜败兵家事不期，包羞忍耻是男儿”。
examples.en: After losing the match the coach said '§'.

examples.zh: “胜败兵家事不期，包羞忍耻是男儿”，一次失败不算什么。
examples.en: '§': one failure is nothing.

story.en: Du Mu visited Wujiang Pavilion, where Xiang Yu killed himself rather than live in shame, and argues that he should have endured.
story.zh: 杜牧过乌江亭，论项羽兵败自刎，认为应忍辱再起。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 江东子弟多才俊，卷土重来未可知
pinyin: jiāng dōng zǐ dì duō cái jùn, juǎn tǔ chóng lái wèi kě zhī
literal: Jiangdong · young men · many · talents · outstanding, roll · dust · again · come · not · can · know
natural: The youth of Jiangdong are many and able; who knows whether they might have returned in force?

meaning.en: After defeat one may rally and come back; quoted for the possibility of a comeback.
meaning.zh: 江东的子弟人才众多，如果卷土重来，结果还很难说，比喻失败后东山再起。

examples.zh: 球队虽然输了，但“江东子弟多才俊，卷土重来未可知”，下赛季还有机会。
examples.en: The team lost, but '§': there's still next season.

examples.zh: 创业失败不要紧，“江东子弟多才俊，卷土重来未可知”。
examples.en: A failed venture is no matter: '§'.

story.en: Du Mu imagines that Xiang Yu could have crossed the Wu River, rallied the young men of Jiangdong and risen again.
story.zh: 杜牧设想项羽若渡乌江，收拾江东子弟，未必不能东山再起。

usage.en: The idiom 卷土重来 derives from this line.
usage.zh: 成语“卷土重来”出自此句。

text: 一骑红尘妃子笑，无人知是荔枝来
pinyin: yī jì hóng chén fēi zǐ xiào, wú rén zhī shì lì zhī lái
literal: one · rider · red · dust · imperial consort · smile, no · one · know · is · lychee · come
natural: One rider raises red dust, and the consort smiles; no one knows it is lychees arriving

meaning.en: Imperial luxury paid for with others' toil; quoted to satirise extravagant privilege.
meaning.zh: 一骑飞驰扬起红尘，贵妃含笑，没人知道是送荔枝来，讽刺权贵的奢靡。

examples.zh: 为了一道鲜货动用专机，真是“一骑红尘妃子笑，无人知是荔枝来”。
examples.en: Chartering a plane for a fresh delicacy is truly '§'.

examples.zh: 历史课上老师讲到“一骑红尘妃子笑，无人知是荔枝来”。
examples.en: The history teacher mentioned '§'.

story.en: Du Mu passed Huaqing Palace and recalled how Emperor Xuanzong had fresh lychees rushed to Yang Guifei from the south.
story.zh: 杜牧过华清宫，讽刺唐玄宗为杨贵妃飞驰送荔枝。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 二十四桥明月夜，玉人何处教吹箫
pinyin: èr shí sì qiáo míng yuè yè, yù rén hé chù jiào chuī xiāo
literal: twenty-four · bridges · bright · moon · night, jade · person · where · teach · blow · flute
natural: On a moonlit night at Twenty-Four Bridges, where is the jade-like lady teaching the flute?

meaning.en: A moonlit Yangzhou evening; quoted for scenery and memory of someone far away.
meaning.zh: 明月夜里二十四桥，那位玉人在哪里教人吹箫，是对扬州月夜的想象和对友人的怀念。

equivalents: wondering who plays the flute under the moon

examples.zh: 到瘦西湖游玩，导游念起“二十四桥明月夜，玉人何处教吹箫”。
examples.en: At Slender West Lake the guide recited '§'.

examples.zh: 扬州的宣传词里常有“二十四桥明月夜，玉人何处教吹箫”。
examples.en: Yangzhou's slogans often include '§'.

story.en: Du Mu wrote to his friend Han Chuo in Yangzhou, remembering the city's moonlit nights.
story.zh: 杜牧寄给在扬州的友人韩绰，追忆扬州月夜。

usage.en: Quoted for Yangzhou tourism; do not confuse with 姜夔's 二十四桥仍在.
usage.zh: 常用于扬州旅游宣传，与姜夔“二十四桥仍在”不同。

text: 二十四桥仍在，波心荡、冷月无声
pinyin: èr shí sì qiáo réng zài, bō xīn dàng, lěng yuè wú shēng
literal: twenty-four · bridges · still · exist, wave · heart · ripple, cold · moon · no · sound
natural: The Twenty-Four Bridges still stand; in the heart of the waves a cold moon ripples without a sound

meaning.en: A city's desolation after war, with only bridge and moon unchanged; quoted for elegiac scenery.
meaning.zh: 二十四桥依旧还在，水波中荡着冷月，无声无息，写战乱之后扬州的萧条。

equivalents: only the bridges and moon remain

examples.zh: 故地重游，繁华已逝，只觉“二十四桥仍在，波心荡、冷月无声”。
examples.en: Revisiting the old place, its splendour gone, I felt only '§'.

examples.zh: 词的结尾“二十四桥仍在，波心荡、冷月无声”，余味悠长。
examples.en: The lyric ends with '§', leaving a lingering aftertaste.

story.en: Jiang Kui passed through Yangzhou in 1176, devastated by the Jin invasions, and wrote this lyric to the tune 'Yangzhou Slow'.
story.zh: 姜夔1176年路过扬州，目睹金兵南侵后的破败，作此词。

usage.en: A lyric (词) line, not a regular-verse (诗) line.
usage.zh: 此为词句，非律诗、绝句之句。

text: 人人尽说江南好，游人只合江南老
pinyin: rén rén jìn shuō jiāng nán hǎo, yóu rén zhǐ hé jiāng nán lǎo
literal: everyone · all · say · Jiangnan · good, travellers · should · Jiangnan · grow old
natural: Everyone says Jiangnan is lovely; a traveller should grow old in Jiangnan

meaning.en: Jiangnan is so beautiful one would want to settle there for life; quoted in praise of the region.
meaning.zh: 人人都说江南好，游子最好就在江南终老，赞美江南。

equivalents: Jiangnan, where one wants to settle
a place worth growing old in

examples.zh: 旅游宣传语是“人人尽说江南好，游人只合江南老”。
examples.en: The tourism slogan is '§'.

examples.zh: 我在杭州住了一年，真觉得“人人尽说江南好，游人只合江南老”。
examples.en: After a year in Hangzhou, I really felt '§'.

story.en: Wei Zhuang, far from the north in troubled times, wrote of Jiangnan in this lyric to the tune 'Bodhisattva Barbarian'.
story.zh: 韦庄漂泊江南时作，借赞江南抒思乡之情。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 黑云压城城欲摧，甲光向日金鳞开
pinyin: hēi yún yā chéng chéng yù cuī, jiǎ guāng xiàng rì jīn lín kāi
literal: black · clouds · press · city · city · about to · collapse, armour · gleam · toward · sun · golden · scales · open
natural: Black clouds press on the city, which seems about to collapse; armour glints in the sun like golden scales opening

meaning.en: A city under siege, with menacing clouds and glinting armour; also used for overwhelming pressure.
meaning.zh: 黑云压城，城墙将摧，将士铠甲在日光下如金鳞闪耀，形容形势危急，兵临城下。

examples.zh: 暴雨来临前，天空正是“黑云压城城欲摧，甲光向日金鳞开”。
examples.en: Before the storm the sky was just '§'.

examples.zh: 考试周期间，压力有点“黑云压城城欲摧，甲光向日金鳞开”。
examples.en: During exam week the pressure was a bit '§'.

story.en: Li He's ballad about a general defending Yanmen against a siege.
story.zh: 李贺写雁门太守抵御围攻的乐府诗。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 今朝有酒今朝醉，明日愁来明日愁
pinyin: jīn zhāo yǒu jiǔ jīn zhāo zuì, míng rì chóu lái míng rì chóu
literal: today · have · wine · today · drunk, tomorrow · worry · come · tomorrow · worry
natural: Drink today if there's wine today; worry tomorrow when tomorrow's worries come

meaning.en: Live for the moment and leave worries for later; sometimes said with a note of fatalism.
meaning.zh: 有酒今天就喝，明天的忧愁明天再说，及时行乐，不为将来发愁。

equivalents: let tomorrow take care of itself

examples.zh: 他月月花光工资，口头禅是“今朝有酒今朝醉，明日愁来明日愁”。
examples.en: He spends his whole pay every month; his motto is '§'.

examples.zh: 朋友劝他存钱，他却说“今朝有酒今朝醉，明日愁来明日愁”。
examples.en: His friends urged him to save, but he said '§'.

story.en: Luo Yin, who failed the exams repeatedly, wrote 'Consoling Myself', saying he'd rather take things as they come.
story.zh: 罗隐屡试不第，作《自遣》以自我排解。

usage.en: Casual, usually a bit self-mocking, and not meant as advice to plan.
usage.zh: 口语化，常带自嘲，并非劝人规划之语。

text: 昔人已乘黄鹤去，此地空余黄鹤楼
pinyin: xī rén yǐ chéng huáng hè qù, cǐ dì kōng yú huáng hè lóu
literal: former · man · already · ride · yellow · crane · go, this · place · empty · remain · Yellow Crane · Tower
natural: The man of old has gone riding a yellow crane; this place leaves only an empty Yellow Crane Tower

meaning.en: The past has vanished leaving only the monument; quoted for changing times and loss.
meaning.zh: 古人已骑黄鹤离去，只留下空荡荡的黄鹤楼，感叹物是人非。

equivalents: the past is gone, only the monument remains
a place emptied of its past

examples.zh: 面对老街拆迁，他念起“昔人已乘黄鹤去，此地空余黄鹤楼”。
examples.en: Seeing the old street demolished he recited '§'.

examples.zh: 登上黄鹤楼，游客纷纷吟诵“昔人已乘黄鹤去，此地空余黄鹤楼”。
examples.en: Atop Yellow Crane Tower tourists chanted '§'.

story.en: Cui Hao's poem on Yellow Crane Tower, which Li Bai is said to have admired and declined to match.
story.zh: 崔颢《黄鹤楼》，相传李白读后搁笔。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 去年今日此门中，人面桃花相映红
pinyin: qù nián jīn rì cǐ mén zhōng, rén miàn táo huā xiāng yìng hóng
literal: last · year · this · day · this · gate · in, person · face · peach · blossoms · each other · set off · red
natural: This day last year, in this very gate, her face and the peach blossoms reflected each other in red

meaning.en: Nostalgia for a lost romance as the scene returns without the person; origin of 人面桃花.
meaning.zh: 去年今日在此门中，人面与桃花互相映红，物是人非，怀念往事。

equivalents: a face like peach blossom, now gone

examples.zh: 故地重游，他想起“去年今日此门中，人面桃花相映红”。
examples.en: Revisiting the place, he thought of '§'.

examples.zh: 电视剧里这句“去年今日此门中，人面桃花相映红”勾起了观众的回忆。
examples.en: The line '§' in the drama stirred viewers' memories.

story.en: Cui Hu, a candidate in Chang'an, met a girl at a village door, and when he returned the next year the door was locked and she was gone.
story.zh: 崔护赴京应试，清明独游城南，遇一女子，次年再访已人去门锁，因题此诗。

usage.en: The four-character 人面桃花 comes from this line.
usage.zh: 四字语“人面桃花”出自此句。

text: 日暮苍山远，天寒白屋贫
pinyin: rì mù cāng shān yuǎn, tiān hán bái wū pín
literal: sun · set · blue-grey · hills · distant, sky · cold · white · house · poor
natural: At sunset the blue hills are far; the sky is cold and the white-walled house is poor

meaning.en: A bleak, cold dusk at a poor mountain home.
meaning.zh: 日落时青山遥远，天寒中白屋清贫，描绘山居的荒寒。

equivalents: a cold dusk at a humble home

examples.zh: 山村的冬夜，真有“日暮苍山远，天寒白屋贫”的意境。
examples.en: A winter night in the mountain village really has the mood of '§'.

examples.zh: 摄影师为照片取名“日暮苍山远，天寒白屋贫”。
examples.en: The photographer titled the picture '§'.

origin.source: 刘长卿《逢雪宿芙蓉山主人》

story.en: Liu Zhangqing, caught by a snowstorm, stayed at a mountain household and wrote this poem.
story.zh: 刘长卿途中遇雪，借宿芙蓉山人家，作此诗。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 独怜幽草涧边生，上有黄鹂深树鸣
pinyin: dú lián yōu cǎo jiàn biān shēng, shàng yǒu huáng lí shēn shù míng
literal: alone · cherish · secluded · grass · stream · beside · grow, above · have · orioles · deep · trees · sing
natural: I love only the secluded grass growing by the stream; above it orioles sing in the deep trees

meaning.en: A fondness for quiet, unassuming things; sometimes read as the poet's self-image.
meaning.zh: 唯独喜爱涧边的幽草，上面深树中黄鹂鸣叫，表达对幽静恬淡的喜爱，也有人解作诗人自况。

examples.zh: 他喜欢清静，常说“独怜幽草涧边生，上有黄鹂深树鸣”。
examples.en: He likes quiet and often says '§'.

examples.zh: 山涧边的野草让她想起“独怜幽草涧边生，上有黄鹂深树鸣”。
examples.en: The wild grass by the stream reminded her of '§'.

story.en: Wei Yingwu, prefect of Chuzhou, wrote the poem about the western stream; the second half describes the evening rain.
story.zh: 韦应物任滁州刺史时所作，后半写晚雨野渡。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 劝君莫惜金缕衣，劝君惜取少年时
pinyin: quàn jūn mò xī jīn lǚ yī, quàn jūn xī qǔ shào nián shí
literal: urge · you · do not · cherish · gold-thread · robe, urge · you · cherish · young · years · time
natural: I urge you not to prize the gold-threaded robe; I urge you to prize your youth

meaning.en: Treasure youth above wealth; quoted to urge making the most of one's younger years.
meaning.zh: 劝你不要珍惜华贵的衣裳，要珍惜青春岁月，劝人珍惜时光。

equivalents: make the most of your youth

examples.zh: 毕业赠言里他写下“劝君莫惜金缕衣，劝君惜取少年时”。
examples.en: In his graduation message he wrote '§'.

examples.zh: “劝君莫惜金缕衣，劝君惜取少年时”，年轻时多学点东西。
examples.en: '§': learn more while you're young.

story.en: A poem attributed to Du Qiuniang, once a singer, urging the young to treasure their time; some editions attribute it as anonymous.
story.zh: 相传为杜秋娘所作，劝人珍惜青春；另有无名氏说。

usage.en: Often followed by 花开堪折直须折; some attribute it as anonymous.
usage.zh: 后接“花开堪折直须折”，作者另有无名氏说。

text: 千锤万凿出深山，烈火焚烧若等闲
pinyin: qiān chuí wàn záo chū shēn shān, liè huǒ fén shāo ruò děng xián
literal: thousand · hammers · ten thousand · chisels · come out · deep · mountain, fierce · fire · burn · as if · ordinary
natural: Through a thousand hammer blows and ten thousand chisels it leaves the deep mountain; roaring fire to it is nothing

meaning.en: Facing hardship with unshaken resolve, like lime from the mountain quarry; quoted for fortitude.
meaning.zh: 经过千锤万凿从深山中取出，烈火焚烧也视若平常，比喻不畏艰险、坚贞不屈。

examples.zh: 老师用“千锤万凿出深山，烈火焚烧若等闲”鼓励大家面对挫折。
examples.en: The teacher used '§' to encourage everyone to face setbacks.

examples.zh: 他的人生正如“千锤万凿出深山，烈火焚烧若等闲”。
examples.en: His life is just like '§'.

story.en: Yu Qian, Ming statesman who defended Beijing in 1449, wrote 'Ode to Lime' as an expression of his integrity; the poem ends 要留清白在人间.
story.zh: 于谦所作，托物言志，末句“要留清白在人间”。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。
